name: io.github.ArtyMcLabin/Gmail-MCP-Server
description: Lean Gmail MCP server with auto authentication support

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the OAuth client keys file path (defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/gcp-oauth.keys.json)

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the stored credentials file path (defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/credentials.json)
environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH
